results.content: ## सी.एस.आई.आर- हिमालय जैवसंपदा प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान, पालमपुर. A Constituent Laboratory of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR). Mission: To discover, innovate, develop and disseminate the processes, products and technologies from Himalayan bioresources for society, industry, environment, and academia. Dr. Sudesh Kumar Yadav, Director, CSIR-IHBT, led the Swachhata Pakhwada (1–15 May 2026) pledge and emphasized the importance of cleanliness in our daily lives. CSIR-IHBT Palampur, HP, in association with NTPC, organized a one-day training cum awareness program on agro and process technology of important aromatic crops for enhancing the livelihood of farmers of Bilaspur, HP, on April 29, 2026, at NTPC, Koldam, Bilaspur, HP. * Applications are invited for multiple training programmes under the CSIR – Integrated Skill Initiative (Phase-III) by CSIR--IHBT. ##### Application/Varieties/Use. Steviosides are used for preparation of pharmaceutical products (helpful for hypoglycemia and diabetes), for flavour enhancer, in food and beverage application as a replacement for sugar and artificial sweeteners, in herbal tea etc.
